Definition: of Hebrew origin (compare H7081); Cosam (i.e. Kosam) an Israelite:--Cosam.
BiblicalUsage: Cosam is an Israelite, a name in the genealogy of Jesus. Luke 3:28 names him the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er, in the line that runs back to Adam.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Cosam's single verse is enough: his name stands in the line of the Messiah, and the genealogy is the proof that Jesus came in the flesh.
